name: Falcomon
main_effect: [On Play] 1 of your purple Digimon gains ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
source_effect: [On Deletion] If not deleted in battle, your opponent trashes 1 card in their hand.
